name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-15 ポルタノヴァ[ホワイト]

description.ja: カスタマイズで量産機の枠を超えろ！
description.en: Go beyond the limits of mass-produced machines with customization!

description.ja: シンプルな構造で組み立てが簡単なBANDAI SPIRITSオリジナルロボットプラモデルシリーズ、「30 MINUTES MISSIONS」から、「bEXM-15 ポルタノヴァ[ホワイト]が1/144スケールで登場。
description.en: From the BANDAI SPIRITS original robot plastic model series, "30 MINUTES MISSIONS ", which has a simple structure and easy assembly, " bEXM-15 Portanova [White]" is now available in 1/144 Scale.

description.ja: • 組み立てが簡単だから、たくさんつくれる！たくさん集めたくなる！
description.en: • Assembly is easy, so you can make a lot! Makes you want to collect a lot!

description.ja: • 同じ機体で複数のカラーバリエーションを展開。塗装なしでも好みのカラーリングを楽しめる。
description.en: • Multiple color variations available with the same aircraft. You can enjoy your favorite coloring without painting.

description.ja: • シリーズ共通の関節構造を採用。異なる機体同士でもユニットの組み換えやパーツ換装が可能。
description.en: • Adopts joint structure common to the series. It is possible to recombine units and replace parts even between different aircraft.

description.ja: • 各所に設けられた３mm穴のハードポイントで様々なカスタマイズが可能。
description.en: • Various customization is possible with the 3mm hole hard points provided in various locations.

description.ja: • ライフルなど各種武装が付属。
description.en: • Various weapons such as rifles are included.
